description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Visualization of a Separated Flow on a Canopy Attached to a Mid-rise Building is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Arindam Gan Chowdhury, Florida International University (fiu.edu). The interaction between flow separation bubbles caused by a separated flow due to canopies attached to buildings is investigated in this study. This data may be reused to assist in the understanding of how separation bubbles interact, as there is no current research on the interaction between separation bubbles. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-7gzy-a168. Keywords: Flow visualization, Canopy, Mid-rise building, Separation bubble, Flow separation, Atmospheric boundary layer. Published 2022-09-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
